title: Zephyr Lamp
text: Zephyr Lamp A Zephyr Lamp is the standard, basic lighting equipped to all crafted ships. A Zephyr Lamp is also the base item required to craft any subsequent ship lighting, such as Shroudlights. Zephyr Lamp Materials
html:
A Zephyr Lamp is the standard, basic lighting equipped to all crafted ships.

A Zephyr Lamp is also the base item required to craft any subsequent ship lighting, such as Shroudlights.
